title: Patch: set pieces: one capped, skippable board-wide beat per action, and a Big moments setting
thread:
**Issue #2785 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2785: Patch: set pieces: one capped, skippable board-wide beat per action, and a Big moments setting
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

The owner wants the biggest moments to own the board for 2–3 seconds: Twisting Nether, Ceaseless Void, a Starship launching, a system's climax (#2782). Today the board can't do that, because R200 says the effects layer paces nothing, and the queue squeezes every burst into `BURST_BUDGET_MS` (2400). #2722 adds the first hold, for a Mythic's takeover (R2722001: `holdMs` on `AnimationEntry`, pinned against the burst budget).

This part makes that hold general. **The set piece** is any entry a card or system marks, and it may hold the game for one capped beat.

The owner chose: a hold, capped, scaled by speed and skippable, with a setting.

### Shape (a suggestion; read `game/animations.ts`, `fx/FxLayer.tsx` and #2722's merged code first)

- **The entry field.**
  - Add `AnimationEntry.setPiece?: { key: string; holdMs: number }`, folding #2722's Mythic `entrance.holdMs` into it, so there is one hold mechanism.
  - Whatever claims an event as a set piece sets the field in `planEntries`: a card table's `{ setPiece: key }` from #2784, or a system row.
- **The budget.**
  - `SET_PIECE_HOLD_MS`, about 2000 at speed 1, plus a hard `SET_PIECE_HOLD_CAP_MS`.
  - At most `SET_PIECES_PER_ACTION = 1` per action. A second set piece in the same burst plays as a plain Signature.
  - The hold is pinned against `BURST_BUDGET_MS` (a burst never squeezes it) and scaled by `scaleForSpeed` (R201). It never goes below `MIN_ENTRY_MS`.
- **Skip.** A tap, a click or Space ends the hold at once: the queue jumps to the entry's end and the effects layer cuts to its tail. It is the first visible skip control, so add a small "Tap to skip" hint that fades in after `SET_PIECE_SKIP_HINT_MS`.
- **The setting.** Add "Big moments" (`full` / `short` / `off`) to the effects settings (`apps/web/src/fx/settings.ts` and the settings panel).
  - `short` is `SET_PIECE_SHORT_HOLD_MS`.
  - `off` plays the entry with no hold, as a Signature.
- **Reduced motion.** No hold, no shake, flash or sweep. A still frame of the moment for `SET_PIECE_STILL_MS`, or none if the queue's reduced-motion drain is synchronous. Pick one and rule it.
- **Where it plays.**
  - Live games, replays (`replay/ReplayPlayer.tsx`) and watching (`together/WatchRoute.tsx`) all play it.
  - The Duos teammate board stays silent.
  - Hotseat plays it for both seats.
- **Sound.** A set piece may name a sound bed: a sequence of existing `apps/web/src/audio/sfx.ts` recipes timed to its phases. Ducking follows the music director's intro duck.
- **Tests.**
  - `cy.settled()` waits for the hold.
  - The e2e smoke still settles.
- **Clocks.** The engine and server clocks are not changed. Note in the ruling that a hold eats into the watching seat's real time, and that `SET_PIECE_HOLD_CAP_MS` bounds it.

The real set pieces (wipes, the Starship, system moments) are their own sub-issues of #2782. This part ships the mechanism and one fixture set piece, shown in the `/dev/fx` gallery.

## Acceptance

- [ ] One hold mechanism: #2722's Mythic hold runs through `setPiece` and plays exactly as before (its tests pass).
- [ ] The hold:
  - is capped at `SET_PIECE_HOLD_CAP_MS`;
  - is scaled by the effects speed;
  - is pinned against the burst budget;
  - happens at most once per action.
  
  Each has a vitest in `game/animations*.test.ts`.
- [ ] A tap, a click or Space skips it, and the game goes on at once (tested, plus a component spec).
- [ ] "Big moments: full / short / off" is in the settings panel, stored with the other effects settings, and each value is tested.
- [ ] Under reduced motion there is no hold, shake or flash (tested).
- [ ] It plays in replays and watch mode, and not on the Duos teammate board (tested).
- [ ] `cy.settled()` waits for it, and the hotseat smoke passes.
- [ ] Every number is a named constant in `apps/web/src/fx/constants.ts` or `game/animations.ts` (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
- [ ] A ruling note in this issue's block amends R200 and R2722001: which entries may hold, the cap, one per action, skip, setting and reduced motion. The §11 paragraph goes in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md`, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

## Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #2722. Part of #2782.
```
